name: Selters (Taunus, Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically red and white with the upper part counterchanged, charged at the top with the municipal arms of Selters (Taunus) (quartered with hammer, pick and fountain).
history: Municipal flag of Selters (Taunus); German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.
